record.title: Establish read-only specimen ADB inventory
record.intent: Discover physical OS, privilege, storage layout and installed software paths before acquisition.
requirements: Commit tasking before execution. Pin offline endpoint evidence; use one candidate ADB endpoint under fresh full capture and host isolation, retaining known host-local background.
Do not run adb root, approve authentication, change device settings, reboot or attach USB. Stop if ordinary access requires these changes or if recorder/isolation fails.

Collect id, getprop, partitions, block nodes and by-name mapping, mounts, processes/listeners, rigol metadata, APK paths and package versions. Do not assume a block-device name or interpret unreadable data as absent.

Preserve private raw output, exact command status and timestamps; restore temporary host state and seal capture with graceful statistics and hashes. Respect lease expiry; renewal requires operator authorization.
acceptance: An observed read-only inventory or precise access blocker is preserved.
